ingredientSections.heading: Mussels and Zucchini Saffron Cream Soup
items: ½ tsp saffron threads (around 6 threads) or ¼ tsp saffron powder

methodSections.heading: Mussels and Zucchini Saffron Cream Soup
steps: Clean and debeard the mussels and discard any that are cracked or open.
Steam the mussels in a large pot with the wine and garlic until they are all open.
Dice the zucchini finely and sauté in a frying pan in the butter for roughly 2 minutes.
Remove the mussels from their shells, discarding any that didn't open, and divide into 4 soup bowls.
Divide the zucchini into the 4 soup bowls, too.
Strain the cooked wine and mussels juices through cheesecloth or a very fine strainer into a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Add cream, saffron, salt and pepper and simmer for 3 minutes.
Pour over the mussels and zucchini and garnish with chopped chives or cilantro.
